item.title: INCLUSIVE FOOTBALL – WALKING & DISABILITY FOOTBALL
item.description: The Daggers Trust held talks with Essex FA and Leisure United last week and will be introducing Walking Football sessions next month at Parsloes Park. The sessions will be open to men and women aged 40+ for a nominal sum eg £2-3 per session, with the first month free of charge. The post INCLUSIVE FOOTBALL – WALKING & DISABILITY FOOTBALL appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.
